title: Top Android Phones to Buy Right Now (2026)
summary: The Galaxy S26 Ultra is the best premium Android phone, the OnePlus 15 leads on battery, the Pixel 11 Pro on camera and the Pixel 10a on value.
method: Picks come from TechRadar, Tom's Guide, Android Central, PhoneArena, BGR, Mobiles.co.uk and T3. Only phones named by at least two of these sources are listed.
assumptions: We show no prices because phone prices and deals change often. The Pixel 11 series and Galaxy Z Fold 8 launched in summer 2026, and some roundups have not fully updated, so check the latest reviews too. OnePlus is exiting the US and Europe, so the OnePlus 15 is only available while stock lasts.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
why: Tom's Guide names the Galaxy S26 Ultra the best Android phone overall and the most capable you can buy. PhoneArena calls it the best premium all-rounder, TechRadar the Android camera phone to beat, and T3 gave it its 2026 Best Phone award.
Android Central highlights the Privacy Display, wider camera apertures for low light and 60W fast wired charging.
pros: Best camera versatility and low-light performance
products.best_for: Anyone who wants the best all-round Android phone
products.skip_if: You want to spend less or prefer a smaller phone
products.amazon_listing: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, Unlocked Android Smartphone, 256GB, Black | Privacy Display, Gal

products.name: OnePlus 15
why: TechRadar names the OnePlus 15 its best overall Android phone and gave it a perfect score, praising its durability and battery life. Tom's Guide lists it as the longest-lasting and best fast-charging Android phone.
Android Central also names the OnePlus 15 among its top picks.
OnePlus confirmed on July 16, 2026 that it is ending new launches in North America and Europe; remaining stock is sold and existing owners keep updates and warranty.
specs: Fast charging that beats any Samsung phone (TechRadar)
cons: OnePlus is leaving the US and Europe, so availability is limited to remaining stock
Camera is not the top pick (TechRadar gives that to Samsung)
products.best_for: People who want the best battery and fast charging
products.skip_if: You want a phone that will keep selling in the US or the best camera
products.amazon_listing: OnePlus 15, 16GB RAM + 512GB Storage, Dual-SIM, Unlocked Android Smartphone, Snapdragon 8

products.name: Google Pixel 11 Pro / Pro XL
products.badge: Best for camera and AI software
why: BGR calls the Pixel 11 Pro XL Google's best camera phone by a comfortable margin and says its main camera may be the best it has used on any Android phone. PhoneArena also titles its review an even better camera phone, and Mobiles.co.uk says the Tensor chip makes it an easy phone to recommend for AI.

Reviews are mixed on everything else: Tom's Guide calls the Pixel 11 Pro disappointing next to rival flagships, BGR finds battery life solid rather than impressive, and the base Pro XL has 12GB RAM, down from 16GB (Mobiles.co.uk).
cons: Performance trails the top Android flagships
Little changed from the Pixel 10 Pro
Base model has less RAM than last year
products.best_for: People who want Google's camera and AI features
products.skip_if: You want the strongest performance or the longest battery

products.name: Google Pixel 10a
why: TechRadar says the Pixel 10a now holds its spot as the best budget Android phone. Tom's Guide lists the Pixel 10a as its best value Android phone.
It brings Google's clean software to a lower price.
products.best_for: Budget buyers who want a good Android phone
products.skip_if: You want flagship cameras and performance
